test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different.

Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and second letter - Difference between the position value according to English alphabetic series is (1).
 
• Second and third letter - Difference between the position value according to English alphabetic series is (3).

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : IJM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e937be37a2472c43664700190c80d7e0fc5be996a912097de493f2d3e127f53.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : ABE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b41ef2997b87a5fdf553f3bbee5907fa4acfc57b70fd8be70844677883f43509.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : XYA

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c52554c2d3ecd4e5bcd698436d2c1019692e150b3b031870b992210788d8d4b0.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : EFI

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4af2ac0a3c0478f8f1e09c243fe819dc9024a4d773009d882a249ffafe7867e1.png] 

Thus, out of all the options **'XYA' is the odd one out as the difference between first and the second letter and difference between second and third letter is (1) and (2) respectively**.

​Hence, **"XYA"** is the correct answer.
